title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector of (0.0, 0.0, 0.375). Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single loop made up of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0242, 0.0). The second line extends from (0.0242, 0.0) to (0.0242, 0.0365). The third line runs from (0.0242, 0.0365) to (0.0, 0.0365), and the fourth line completes the loop by connecting (0.0, 0.0365) back to the origin. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0365. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles of (0.0, 0.0, 0.0) and translating it using the vector (0.0, 0.0, 0.375). Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.1875 units in both the normal and opposite directions to create a three-dimensional rectangular prism. Perform a boolean operation to create a new solid body from this extrusion. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism are 0.02419354838709677 meters in length, 0.03647177419354838 meters in width, and 0.375 meters in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch for the rectangular cross-section
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0242, 0).lineTo(0.0242, 0.0365).lineTo(0, 0.0365).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical object
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Translate the object to the specified position
cylinder = cylinder.translate((0, 0, 0.375))

# Final model
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0242, 0.0)
    .lineTo(0.0242, 0.0365)
    .lineTo(0.0, 0.0365)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D shape
extruded_shape = sketch.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Translate the shape to the specified position
translated_shape = extruded_shape.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.375))

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = translated_shape

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0242, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0242, 0.0365) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0365) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular prism
r = r.extrude(0.1875, both=True)

# Translate the object to the specified position
r = r.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.375))
